row: This channel is built for veterinarians, technicians, horse owners, and veterinary students who know equine dentistry is more than smoothing a few points — it’s one of the most impactful ways to improve a horse’s health. Dr. Nick Moore has dedicated his career to equine dentistry, training and teaching across the U.S. and internationally while shaping a thoughtful, horse-centered approach grounded in anatomy, precision, and clinical reasoning. His work includes standing oral extractions, minimally invasive oral surgery, oral–nasal sinus procedures, and advanced diagnostic techniques — all performed on the sedated, standing horse. No shortcuts. No theatrics. Just evidence-guided dentistry that puts the horse first. Here, he shares what actually matters: real cases, practical techniques, diagnostic thinking, and the subtle details that elevate outcomes. If you want to see equine dentistry differently and raise the standard of care for the horses in your life — you’re in the right place.
